    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Introductory Note</b>
    </div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">As previously disclosed, on April 21, 2026, NHC/OP, L.P., a Delaware limited partnership (the &#8220;Purchaser&#8221;) and a wholly-owned subsidiary of National HealthCare Corporation (&#8220;NHC&#8221;), on behalf of itself and its affiliates identified in the Purchase Agreement, each of which is a wholly-owned subsidiary of NHC (collectively, together with the Purchaser, &#8220;we,&#8221; &#8220;us,&#8221; or &#8220;our&#8221;) entered into a Purchase and Sale Agreement (the &#8220;Purchase Agreement&#8221;) with National Health Investors, Inc. (&#8220;NHI&#8221;), a publicly-traded real estate investment trust, on behalf of itself and its affiliates identified in the Purchase Agreement (collectively, together with NHI, the &#8220;Seller Parties&#8221;), to purchase from the Seller Parties the land, facilities, and improvements, including 32 skilled nursing facilities and three independent living facilities (collectively, the &#8220;Property,&#8221; and with respect to the 35 facilities, the &#8220;Facilities&#8221;), currently leased by us, as tenant, from the Seller Parties, as landlord, under a Master Agreement to Lease dated October 17, 1991, as amended, and those single Facility leases executed by the parties (collectively, the &#8220;Master Lease&#8221;). The purchase and sale of the Property and other transactions contemplated by the Purchase Agreement are referred to herein as the &#8220;Transaction.&#8221;</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">As also previously disclosed, on May 26, 2026, NHC entered into a Credit Agreement (the &#8220;Credit Agreement&#8221;) among NHC, as borrower, certain subsidiaries of NHC, as the guarantors (the &#8220;Guarantors&#8221;), the lenders from time to time party thereto (the &#8220;Lenders&#8221;), and Bank of America, N.A. (&#8220;Bank of America&#8221;), as administrative agent, swingline lender and issuer of letters of credit. The initial funding under the Credit Agreement was conditioned upon, among other things, and was contemplated to occur on the same date as the consummation of the Transaction.</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">On July 1, 2026 (the &#8220;Closing Date&#8221;), the Transaction was consummated in accordance with the Purchase Agreement. Pursuant to the Purchase Agreement, the purchase price paid by us to the Seller Parties was $560&#160;million in cash (the &#8220;Purchase Price&#8221;). The Purchase Price was funded by borrowings under the Credit Agreement, as amended, and cash on hand.</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Item 1.01 Entry into a Material Definitive Agreement.</b>
    </div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">On June 29, 2026, NHC entered into a first amendment to the Credit Agreement (the &#8220;First Amendment&#8221;) among NHC, the Guarantors, the Lenders, and Bank of America, as administrative agent. The First Amendment increased the senior unsecured revolving credit facility under the Credit Agreement from $50 million to $75 million. The First Amendment did not modify the other terms and conditions of the Credit Agreement described in NHC&#8217;s Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;SEC&#8221;) on May&#160;27, 2026 (the &#8220;May&#160;27th Current Report&#8221;). The Credit Agreement as amended by the First Amendment is hereinafter referred to as the &#8220;Credit Agreement.&#8221;</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">On the Closing Date, contemporaneously with the consummation of the Transaction, we and the Seller Parties entered into a Partial Master Lease Termination Agreement and Partial Assignment and Assumption of Master Lease (the &#8220;Master Lease Termination Agreement&#8221;), in substantially the form previously filed as an exhibit to NHC&#8217;s Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the SEC on April&#160;21, 2026 (the &#8220;April 21st Current Report&#8221;). Pursuant to the Master Lease Termination Agreement (i)&#160;the Master Lease was terminated with respect to all of the Facilities other than the four skilled nursing facilities located in Florida (the &#8220;Florida Facilities&#8221;), which are subleased to a third-party operator, and (ii)&#160;the Seller Parties assigned to a wholly-owned subsidiary of NHC, and such NHC subsidiary assumed, the Master Lease with respect to the Florida Facilities.</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">The information set forth in Item 1.01 of the May&#160;27th Current Report and Item 1.01 of the April 21st Current Report is incorporated by reference into this Item 1.01 to the extent such information is responsive to the disclosure requirements of Item 1.01 of Current Report on Form 8-K.</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">The foregoing summary descriptions of the terms of the First Amendment and the Master Lease Termination Agreement are qualified in their entirety by the full text of the First Amendment and the Master Lease Termination Agreement, respectively, copies of which are filed as Exhibits 10.1 and 10.2 to this report and incorporated by reference herein.</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Item 1.02 Termination of a Material Definitive Agreement.</b>
    </div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">The information set forth in Item 1.01 of this report, Item 1.01 of the April&#160;21st Current Report, and Item 1.01 of the May&#160;27th Current Report is incorporated by reference into this Item 1.02 to the extent such information is responsive to the disclosure requirements of Item 1.02 of Current Report on Form 8-K.</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">On the Closing Date, as contemplated by the Credit Agreement, NHC terminated all commitments to lend under that existing Credit Agreement dated as of August 1, 2024 (the &#8220;Existing Credit Agreement&#8221;) among NHC, as borrower, certain of NHC&#8217;s subsidiaries, as guarantors, and Bank of America. As of immediately prior to such termination, there were no outstanding borrowings or other amounts due under the Existing Credit Agreement.</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div class="PGBK" style="margin:0;padding:0;width:100%;">
      <div class="PGFTR" style="width:100%;"></div>
      <hr style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER:always;background-color:#000000;border:none;color:#000000;height:2px;width:100%;"/>
      <div class="PGHDR" style="width:100%;"></div>
    </div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman, Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Item 2.01 Completion of Acquisition or Disposition of Assets.</b>
    </div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">The information set forth in the Introductory Note to this report and in Item 1.01 of the April&#160;21st Current Report is incorporated by reference into this Item 2.01 to the extent such information is responsive to the disclosure requirements of Item 2.01 of Current Report on Form 8-K. The Purchase Price was determined through arms&#8217; length negotiations between our management and NHI management, and the Transaction was unanimously approved by the disinterested directors (as that term is used in Section 144 of the Delaware General Corporation Law) of NHC.</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">The summary description of the terms of the Purchase Agreement and the Transaction provided in this report and in Item 1.01 of the April 21st Current Report does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by the full text of the Purchase Agreement, a copy of which was filed as Exhibit 10.1 to the April 21st Current Report and is incorporated by reference herein.</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Item 2.03 Creation of a Direct Financial Obligation or an Obligation under an Off-Balance Sheet Arrangement of a Registrant.</b>
    </div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">The information set forth in the Introductory Note of this report, Item 1.01 of this report, and Item 1.01 of the May&#160;27th Current Report is incorporated by reference into this Item 2.03 to the extent such information is responsive to the disclosure requirements of Item 2.03 of Current Report on Form 8-K.</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">On the Closing Date, pursuant to the terms of the Credit Agreement, NHC drew down the entire $475 million under the senior unsecured term loan facility and $55 million under the senior unsecured revolving credit facility to pay a portion of the Purchase Price and other fees and expenses related to the Transaction.</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">The summary description of the terms of the Credit Agreement and NHC&#8217;s financial obligations under the Credit Agreement provided in this report and in Item 1.01 of the May&#160;27th Current Report does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by the full text of the Credit Agreement, a copy of which was filed as Exhibit 10.1 to the May&#160;27th Current Report and a copy of the First Amendment is filed as Exhibit 10.1 to this report, and is incorporated by reference herein.</div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure.</b>
    </div>
    <div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">On July 1, 2026, NHC issued a press release announcing the closing of the Transaction. A copy of the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this report and is incorporated herein by reference.</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">&#160;</div>
    <div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">The information in this Item 7.01, including in Exhibit 99.1 to this report, shall not be deemed &#8220;filed&#8221; for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &#8220;Exchange Act&#8221;), or otherwise subject to the liabilities under that Section and such information shall not be deemed to be incorporated by reference into any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, whether made before or after the date hereof, regardless of any general incorporation by reference language in any such filing, except as NHC expressly sets forth by specific reference in such filing.</div>
